title: Book Two · Chapter 134: The Long Hot Week
story:
The last hot week before the summer holiday feels very long. Ronan is twelve. His classroom window is open, but the air barely moves.

At lunch, Leo puts his head on his arms.

“I want to be a fish.”

“Fish still need lunch,” Ronan says.

“Lunch can swim past me.”

Mei has made a fan from old paper. She moves it slowly over her own face. Jun is reading at the next desk.

“Can that fan reach four people?” Leo asks.

“It can reach one,” Mei says.

She hands him a spare sheet. Leo folds it into a narrow strip. It makes a poor fan and a good little stick.

Ronan shows him a wider fold. Soon the two boys have fans. Jun makes one too, but his first edge is crooked.

Mei looks at the three fans.

“A very important school display.”

They laugh. Jun fans his tree book for a moment.

“Do books get hot?” Ronan asks.

“The owner does.”

That afternoon, Miss Wu gives them a free choice of reading. No cards. No questions at the end. They can read one thing they like.

Ronan chooses a short funny story. A man puts his hat on a chair. His wife sits on it, then carries it to the kitchen on her skirt. The man searches every room for the hat.

Ronan laughs before he reaches the last line. Leo leans over.

“Show me.”

“Choose your own page first.”

“This one. I choose your page.”

Ronan finishes the story. Then he puts the page between them. They read it aloud in low voices. Mei asks why they are laughing. Soon four heads are over the same paper.

Miss Wu passes their table. She sees the hat picture and smiles.

“Keep enough room for the paper.”

Jun moves his elbow. Ronan takes his fan off the page. They finish the last line together.

At home, Ronan tells Dad the story. Dad looks for his own cap at once. It is on the shelf, exactly where he left it.

Mum sits down slowly and looks over her shoulder.

“Not here.”

Dad bows to her. “A safe chair.”

After supper, they move their chairs near the doorway. The air is cooler now. Ronan brings out his paper fan. Dad borrows it and makes three great sweeps.

The thin paper tears at the edge.

“A powerful reader,” Ronan says.

“A weak fan,” Dad replies.

Ronan tapes the small tear the next day. He wants the fan for the holiday. He wants the funny story too. Before school closes, he asks to borrow the page.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

fan＝扇子；barely＝几乎不；crooked＝歪的；borrow＝借用。

## 理解问题

1. 自由阅读活动为什么让四个同伴聚到一起？
2. Ronan给父母复述了怎样的故事？

## 读句子

**Jun / moves / his elbow.** Jun／挪开／他的胳膊肘。
